claim: The Trajectory Engine reads where a life has been HEADING — the DIRECTION and momentum of the things Vera already tracks — from a SEQUENCE of nightly significance snapshots (continuity), never from a single point. It is a CONTINUITY read, not prediction, and above all NOT diagnosis: a trend like 'sleep down, stress up' reads descriptively as 'this stretch has been trending toward more strain', and the load-bearing NO-DIAGNOSIS wall scrubs every generated line so it can never tell the person they're 'burning out', 'depressed', 'anxious', or to 'see a professional'. With fewer than two snapshots it returns an honest 'not enough history yet' and fabricates no direction (Observed > Assumed). The same banned-term wall it builds is the one wired into the live chat-reply gate.
owner: anima/trajectory.py (trajectory = per-subject direction/momentum/confidence/evidence read FROM meaning.snapshots continuity; composite = descriptive convergence read; _is_clean / BANNED_TERMS = the NO-DIAGNOSIS wall, a SUPERSET of meaning's terms plus forecast-creep terms; render_trajectory = warm spine-style binding block; snapshot_trajectory = optional append-only ledger, its ONLY write), anima/meaning.py (meaning.snapshots = the append-only significance ledger trajectory reads, READ-ONLY), anima/mouth.py (_diagnosis_terms() PREFERS trajectory.BANNED_TERMS for the live chat-reply no-diagnosis gate _scan_diagnosis/_strip_diagnosis_sentences; _strip_scaffold_leak() unions trajectory.TRAJECTORY_SCAFFOLD_TOKENS so no trajectory tag leaks into a shipped reply)

killer_test.name: direction_from_continuity_and_hard_refusal_of_diagnosis
killer_test.setup: Hermetic temp store (meaning.STORE + trajectory.STORE redirected via _temp_store). Seed the meaning significance ledger directly (trajectory owns no writer; meaning is the source) with a SEQUENCE of snapshots where work RISES, sleep FALLS, reading holds flat, exercise FALLS. (A) trajectory(name) is ready (>=2 snapshots), reads the full sequence, and composes per-subject directions FROM the continuity: work=RISING, sleep=FALLING, reading=STABLE, each object citing the score_path/slope evidence it was built on. (B) the composite names the convergence DESCRIPTIVELY ('toward more strain', subjects include sleep+work) and is clean. (C) NO-DIAGNOSIS WALL: every generated line (per-subject + composite + rendered items) passes _is_clean; _is_clean catches 'you sound depressed'/'this is burnout'/'you will spiral'/'poor prognosis'/'see a therapist'; and a synthetic statement carrying a banned term is REPLACED by its clean fallback by _safe_statement; render_trajectory's guardrail forbids diagnosis+prediction. (D) the SAME wall is the live reply gate: mouth._diagnosis_terms() == trajectory.BANNED_TERMS and mouth._strip_diagnosis_sentences drops a diagnosis sentence from a chat reply, and trajectory.TRAJECTORY_SCAFFOLD_TOKENS are all scrubbed by mouth._strip_scaffold_leak. (E) HONEST EMPTY: a life with <2 snapshots is ready=False with an honest reason, no objects, render=='', composite()==None. Real .anima byte-unchanged. scripts/certify_trajectory_engine.py is the executable form.
killer_test.prompt: how have things been heading for me lately?

known_gaps: Trajectory is internal cognition with NO user-facing endpoint/UI/CLI of its own (user_visible_entry=false): its live effect is INDIRECT — it (1) supplies the BANNED_TERMS that the live mouth chat-reply no-diagnosis gate enforces on every shipped reply, and (2) renders an optional binding block the mouth can fold into a generated reply. The deterministic backend + the no-diagnosis wall + the mouth wiring are proven offline here; a fully GENERATED reply that visibly carries the direction read rides on the live model (gate0_prime_experience's job), out of scope for this hermetic cert. Hence PARTIAL, honestly, rather than a forced COMPLETE.
